name: web-four-service-cards-in-red-white-grey-and-blue-with-3d-object-icons
title: Two-by-two service cards in red, white, grey and blue with 3D objects: bowling pins, chess queen, spider and notepad
whatItIs: A 2x2 grid of rounded cards: a red 'Gamification Marketing' with bowling pins and a ball, a white 'Graphic Design' with a black chess queen, a light grey 'Analytics and Tracking' with a black widow spider and a blue 'Content Creation' with a notepad and pencil, each with a bold title at the top left, a small LEARN MORE arrow link at the bottom left and a 3D object cropped at the bottom right.
whatItMeans: Bold and witty; each 3D object is a visual pun for the service.
techniques: Use one 3D metaphor object per card.
Crop the object at the bottom corner.
Colour-block cards in red and blue with white and grey.

vocabulary.definition: A 3D item standing for a service.
An illustration cut by the card's corner.
A small caps link with an arrow.
